title: Best Credit Card in Australia Currently
body:
Hi everyone,
I’m planning to get a new credit card and would love to hear your recommendations based on your personal experiences.
I’m mainly looking for a card that offers a good balance of cashback, low or reasonable annual fees, strong rewards and useful everyday benefits.
I pay my credit card balance in full every month, so interest rates aren’t a major concern. My focus is on getting the best overall return from everyday spending, whether that’s through cashback, rewards points, travel benefits, complimentary insurance, purchase protection, or any other worthwhile features.
If there are any current sign-up offers that are particularly worthwhile, I’d be interested to know about those as well.
